results.content:
These actions result from a Section 232 investigation initiated on April 15, 2025. The investigation assessed the national security risks related to imports of critical minerals, including rare earth elements. The investigation included imports of critical mineral oxides, oxalates, salts, and metals (processed critical minerals) as well as their derivative products.
